name: Gleaming Crescent Necklace
summary: A gleaming crescent necklace bears an inscription linking it to Maliynn in Astranaar. You can return the keepsake to its owner.

sections.title: The Inscription
sections.body: You examine a silver necklace shaped like a crescent moon. Its form recalls other night elf symbols you have seen, and an inscription on its reverse reads, “Alor'lormah, Maliynn.” The name points to Maliynn in Astranaar, where the necklace may find its owner.

sections.title: Maliynn's Keepsake
sections.body: Maliynn in Astranaar recognizes the necklace as hers. She lost it while carrying supplies to an outpost, then searched along the road before giving up. Her late parents gave it to her, and its return means much to her.

faq.q: Who does the necklace belong to?
faq.answer: The inscription bears Maliynn's name, and she recognizes the necklace as hers in Astranaar.

faq.q: What does the necklace look like?
faq.answer: It is a silver necklace shaped like a small crescent moon.

faq.q: What is written on the necklace?
Where can I bring the necklace?
faq.answer: Bring the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.

faq.q: Why does the necklace matter to Maliynn?
faq.answer: It was a gift from her late parents.
Maliynn lost it while delivering supplies to one of her outposts. She searched along the road before giving up.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may recognize the crescent shape among the symbols you have seen.
